input.description: Sunday church service and Sunday school with the family.
Morning circle time in a kindergarten classroom: calendar, weather, the days of the week, and a song.
Bedtime routine: bath, pajamas, brushing teeth, a story, and lights out.
Asking for a sensory break when the classroom is too loud: a quiet corner, headphones, squeeze ball.

Tomorrow we're doing a cooking activity in speech group. Four kids, ages 5-7, two of them are new to their devices. We'll make pancakes together: everyone gets a turn to pour, stir, and flip. I want them requesting the next step, commenting on what they see (it's bubbling, it's hot), and asking for a turn. One child has an egg allergy so we use an egg-free mix. We finish by eating them with syrup and fruit.
A trip to the shooting range with uncle.
